page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn8te.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture bare-metal instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance integrates hardware acceleration via eight NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs, delivering a combined total of 384 GB of VRAM. Networking capabilities are supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 170 Gbps. However, the instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage options. It also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high-density GPU configuration and substantial dedicated compute resources, this server is designed for intensive parallel processing workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale deep learning training, complex AI inference, high-fidelity graphics rendering, and massive data parallel processing. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the consolidation of eight enterprise-grade GPUs and 128 dedicated vCPUs on a single bare-metal host minimizes inter-node latency and overhead, though the lack of local storage requires careful architectural planning for data-heavy pipelines.

Hardware acceleration is provided by eight NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPUs with a combined 384 GB of VRAM, making it highly suitable for deep learning, AI model training, and parallel computing. The instance offers a baseline network bandwidth of 170 Gbps to support high-throughput data transfers. A key architectural tradeoff is the absence of local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. This server is optimized for enterprise-scale artificial intelligence, data science, and complex rendering workloads where high-density GPU compute and dedicated CPU resources are required.
